messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — we have two big pulls on the same release window: ACME SSO pilot (customer-driven) and the internal routing rewrite. We can’t reasonably ship both in the next milestone. Thoughts?
Jonah: Ack. The routing rewrite needs at least one more backend sprint, maybe two. Can we scope down to a minimal compatibility shim for the pilot?
Priya: The pilot has strict SSO and auditing asks. ACME wants SAML + audit logs, and they’ll validate this week. If we delay, they may push production date.
Marco: From CS — ACME is high priority and willing to beta with known caveats, but they want stable latency and an audit trail. They'd accept a reduced UX surface if guarantees hold.
Sam: Design can short-circuit some screens. If we ship SSO only for core flows and hide advanced settings, we can reduce scope.
Elaine: Proposal: freeze routing rewrite (defer non-blocking parts) and swap priority so ACME SSO pilot is in the upcoming milestone. Keep canonical routing work for v1. Can we make that safe?
Jonah: Technically feasible if we implement a config-layer fallback and a lightweight proxy. Risk: temporary ops complexity and ~10% perf hit on some endpoints.
Priya: Ops/infra impact sounds manageable if we have a rollback plan and clear SLA exceptions. Need sign-off from eng-sre. @OpsBot can you annotate the canary window?
OpsBot: Deploy plan created: canary throughput 10% for 48h. Alert thresholds: 2xx ratio < 99.5% or p95 latency > 300ms.
Elaine: Great — what about quality gates? We should lock a prompt-eval battery and an embedding-regression check before pilot go/no-go.
Marco: I'll coordinate with ACME to run the evals against their traffic patterns. If regressions are within 3% we proceed.
Sam: I'll prepare the abbreviated UX flows and a small feature flag to hide advanced SSO settings.
Jonah: Backlog items to move: routing-rewrite-core (defer), proxy-fallback (add), sso-integration (promote). I'll update sprint board now.
Priya: Budget/capacity note: swapping work pushes a GPU reservation change in week+2. I'll flag finance.
Elaine: Decision: swap-in ACME SSO pilot. Defer routing rewrite non-essential items to v1. Action owners: Jonah (eng), Sam (design), Marco (cs), Priya (infra). Target milestone: next release candidate.
Jonah: Added tasks and assigned owners. ETA for PRs: 5 working days for the proxy + 3 for SSO connector.
Marco: I'll ask ACME to accept the reduced surface and confirm their QA window next Wed.
Elaine: Thanks all. If any blockers pop up, post here and we’ll triage immediately. :thumbsup:
thread_text_excerpt: Elaine kicks off a scope swap: prioritize customer SSO pilot over routing rewrite; action owners and canary plan agreed.
